title: Port ESG data model: JSON Schema bundle
description: Ingestion batch envelope: one table, many records.

source_system.title: source_system
source_system.description: Registry of every system or channel that feeds the platform, classified A-H.

entity.title: entity
entity.description: Organisational hierarchy: port > terminal > business unit / facility / tenant. Drives reporting boundaries.

evidence_document.title: evidence_document
evidence_document.description: Uploaded evidence (invoices, certificates, manifests) with content hash for audit.

tenant.title: tenant
tenant.description: Tenants, concessionaires and contractors. operational_control decides Scope 1/2 vs Scope 3.

vessel.title: vessel
vessel.description: Vessel master data (IMO registry, class and engine particulars).

vessel_call.title: vessel_call
vessel_call.description: One row per vessel call; the anchor for Scope 3 vessel emissions (TOS / PCS / berth planning).

asset.title: asset
asset.description: Port-owned equipment: cranes, RTGs, trucks, generators, buildings.

ais_position.title: ais_position
ais_position.description: AIS position reports for approach and manoeuvring emission estimates. High volume: partition by month.

container_move.title: container_move
container_move.description: Container / cargo moves from the TOS, linked to equipment for per-asset energy intensity.

gate_transaction.title: gate_transaction
gate_transaction.description: Truck gate events; basis for turnaround time and idling emissions.

meter.title: meter
meter.description: Meter registry. scope_boundary says whose consumption it is.

meter_register_reading.title: meter_register_reading
meter_register_reading.description: Cumulative register (odometer) readings keyed in or read from a photo by field operators. Consumption since the previous validated reading is derived into energy_meter_reading once approved.

energy_meter_reading.title: energy_meter_reading
energy_meter_reading.description: Interval readings from smart meters / SCADA. High volume: partition by month or use a time-series extension.

fuel_transaction.title: fuel_transaction
fuel_transaction.description: Fuel dispensed to assets (Scope 1 mobile and stationary combustion).

shore_power_session.title: shore_power_session
shore_power_session.description: Shore-power (cold ironing) sessions per vessel call.

refrigerant_event.title: refrigerant_event
refrigerant_event.description: Refrigerant top-ups from maintenance work orders (CMMS); basis for fugitive emissions.

sensor.title: sensor
sensor.description: Environmental sensor registry (air, water, noise, weather).

air_quality_reading.title: air_quality_reading
air_quality_reading.description: Air quality readings in ug/m3 (CO in mg/m3).

water_record.title: water_record
water_record.description: Water withdrawal, discharge and recycling volumes by entity and period (GRI 303).

weather_observation.title: weather_observation
weather_observation.description: Weather and tide observations used to normalise and contextualise readings.

spend_record.title: spend_record
spend_record.description: Procurement spend (ERP) used for Scope 3 purchased goods and services.

utility_invoice.title: utility_invoice
utility_invoice.description: Utility invoices; cross-check against meter data.

employee_snapshot.title: employee_snapshot
employee_snapshot.description: Aggregated HR snapshot per period. Aggregates only: no individual-level personal data.

training_record.title: training_record
training_record.description: Aggregated training hours per period and category.

hours_worked.title: hours_worked
hours_worked.description: Exposure hours: the denominator for LTIFR / TRIR.

safety_incident.title: safety_incident
safety_incident.description: Safety incidents and near-misses from the HSE system.

policy.title: policy
policy.description: Governance policies and their review cycle.

framework.title: framework
framework.description: Reporting frameworks (GRI, IFRS S1/S2, TCFD, SASB, CDP, local regulator).

metric.title: metric
metric.description: Metric catalog: links raw data to KPIs and disclosures.

metric_requirement_map.title: metric_requirement_map
metric_requirement_map.description: Many-to-many mapping of metrics to framework disclosures.

emission_factor.title: emission_factor
emission_factor.description: Versioned emission factors. Never overwrite: add a new row with a new validity window.

climate_hazard.title: climate_hazard
climate_hazard.description: Physical climate hazard projections per location / scenario.

tenant_esg_submission.title: tenant_esg_submission
tenant_esg_submission.description: Metric values submitted by tenants and contractors, with review workflow.

shipping_line_data.title: shipping_line_data
shipping_line_data.description: Voluntary shipping-line disclosures: berth fuel use, ETS and CII.

survey_response.title: survey_response
survey_response.description: Stakeholder survey scores used in double-materiality assessment.

calc_run.title: calc_run
calc_run.description: A calculation run: pins the factor-set version so results are reproducible.

kpi_target.title: kpi_target
kpi_target.description: Baselines and targets per metric and entity.

ghg_activity_data.title: ghg_activity_data
ghg_activity_data.description: Normalised activity data feeding the GHG inventory, with lineage back to source rows.

ghg_emission.title: ghg_emission
ghg_emission.description: Calculated emissions per activity and gas.

kpi_value.title: kpi_value
kpi_value.description: Computed KPI values per metric, entity and period, with status versus target.
